meta.name: lark-workflow-standup-report
meta.description: 日程待办摘要：编排 calendar +agenda 和 task +get-my-tasks，生成指定日期的日程与未完成任务摘要。适用于了解今天/明天/本周的安排。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动汇总日程与待办，生成每日工作摘要
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每天需要快速了解当日日程和未完成任务
copy.tagline_en: Automatically summarize calendar and tasks for daily standup
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a quick daily summary of your schedule and pending tasks

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会先读取认证说明，然后调用日程和任务工具，获取指定日期的日程与未完成任务，按时间排序、检测冲突，生成含会议表、待办清单和小结的摘要。
howto.when: 当用户询问今天、明天或本周的安排，或要求生成早报/standup 摘要时触发。

say.note: 会获取今天的日程和未完成任务并生成摘要。

say.text: 帮我生成本周的日程和待办摘要。
say.note: 会拉取本周日程与未完成待办并汇总。

say.text: 请生成今天的 standup 报告。
say.note: 会获取今天日程和到期待办，按格式输出摘要。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude first reads the auth guide, then calls calendar and task tools, gets the schedule and unfinished to-dos for the given date, sorts by time, detects conflicts, and produces a summary with a meeting table, to-do list, and recap.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks about today's, tomorrow's, or this week's schedule, or asks for a morning/standup summary.

say_en.note: Gets today's calendar and open tasks and creates a summary.

say_en.text: Generate a summary of this week's schedule and to-dos.
say_en.note: Fetches this week's events and unfinished tasks and summarizes them.

say_en.text: Please create a standup report for today.
say_en.note: Gets today's events and due tasks and formats the summary.
